question: Using treasury_yield_curve_2023.csv (daily par yields, percent), on how many trading days in 2023 did the 2 Yr yield exceed the 10 Yr yield by at least 0.50 percentage points (2 Yr minus 10 Yr >= 0.50)?
solve_py:
import os,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/treasury_yield_curve_2023.csv')
print(int(((d['2 Yr']-d['10 Yr'])>=0.5-1e-9).sum()))
